sections.Profile:
"Whirl-Wind" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in December 1957.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1957
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Wood Rail, Dancing, Original Theme
